verdict.rationale: Docs show permission types including 'domain' and 'anyone' at the file/API level (google-drive-docs-7, google-drive-docs-25), implying some domain-scoped sharing control, but there's no documentation of org-wide Admin Console policies for restricting external sharing, domain allowlists, or link-restriction enforcement. Community evidence even suggests uncontrolled external sharing spam reaching users (google-drive-comm-10, google-drive-comm-11), hinting governance isn't robustly surfaced or enforced in the given evidence. Missing for 10: Admin Console-level external sharing policy docs, domain allowlist configuration, link-restriction enforcement evidence, and independent confirmation these controls work as intended.
